ruling: Same receipt_consumer route as input tvc (StegVerse-Labs/TVC#539): repo-standards' own CI runs OwnerDriftTests against its schema at an exact public org commit and seals a test receipt; this repository consumes that receipt from its organization ledger chain and never reads repo-standards source. Replaces the private-source read (REPO_STANDARDS_ROOT, TVC-PRIVATE-SOURCE-READ-001), whose credential grant is not activated (TVC docs/PRIVATE_SOURCE_READ_MIRROR_HANDOFF.md, 'credential/grant activation: NOT OBSERVED').

producer.run_block: tools/tasks/task_catalog.json group org-owner-drift-receipt (hosted by .github/workflows/test-suite.yml job owner-drift-receipt; G17: no workflow file of its own)

receipt.seal: receipt_sha256 = sha256 of the canonical JSON body (organization_ledger_readback.self_verifies)

ledger.retained_as: source-receipts/<receipt_sha256>.json consumed by an organization transition receipt
ledger.appended_by: this organization's ledger writer only; neither repo-standards CI nor the full-suite job appends

surface_paths_observed_at.method: the producer's configured binding_paths, each of which its audit-hook trace must show opened (repo-standards tools/org_owner_drift_receipt.py run)
